answer_1.quote: In the field of natural language processing, many efforts have been made to enhance computational models... encoder‑decoder architectures have become a widely used approach for sequence‑to‑sequence tasks such as machine translation, text summarization and dialogue generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences (re‑ordered from a bag of words)

answer_2.quote: We employ four automatic evaluation metrics to evaluate the quality of a generated sentence from different aspects. PMR (Perfect Matching Ratio), BLEU, ROUGE‑L, WAcc (Word Accuracy).

answer_4.quote: We invited humans to organize the target sentence regarding the input bag using crowd‑sourcing. Each bag was randomly presented to 3 judges and we retain the answer with the highest BLEU score. Annotators were asked to judge whether a generated sentence is grammatical and the meaning of a generated sentence is the same as the ground truth.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges evaluated grammaticality and semantic fidelity (whether the meaning matches the ground truth), often using BLEU as a reference metric.
